evidence.quote: Under API Token, click Generate or Regenerate.
Log in to ClickUp. In the upper-right corner, click your avatar. Select Settings. In the sidebar, click Apps...Under API Token, click Generate or Regenerate.
Approximately 171 distinct API endpoints are documented in the ClickUp REST API reference.
Our MCP server URL is https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp.
ClickUp's MCP Server is available on all plans.

result.notes: Personal API tokens are self-serve and free for any ClickUp account (generated instantly from user Settings > Apps), no approval needed for personal/testing use; OAuth2 apps require creating an app but no gating beyond that was documented. ClickUp also ships an official first-party MCP server (public beta, all plans) at mcp.clickup.com, in addition to several community MCP servers on GitHub/Smithery.
result.one_liner: ClickUp is a productivity/project-management platform (tasks, docs, goals, chat) with a REST API for workspace automation.
